title_zh: 约定公布已确认阵容而不承诺曲目

scenario.label_zh: 约定公布已确认阵容而不承诺曲目
scenario.goal_zh: 确认歌手回归但曲目未定，并约定公告说明阵容、感谢歌迷而不承诺特定歌曲

context_zh: 虚构社区音乐会的两位组织者准备公告，尚未发布任何内容。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Is Mara definitely back in the lineup, or are we still waiting for her answer?

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: She's confirmed she'll sing. Her longtime fans will be delighted.

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Can we promise she'll perform River Road? People keep asking.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: No. She hasn't chosen her songs yet. Returning to the concert isn't a promise about the set list.

sentences.speaker: Dana
sentences.text: Then the announcement should name her and thank the audience for their loyalty, without naming songs.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: Exactly. I'll draft it that way, and we'll add the set list only if she confirms it.
